turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting vision system diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: First, inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. Second, check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. Third, inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. 2. Check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. 3. Inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All three checks completed. The lens element is clear, housing is intact, and the mount face is clean.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. 2. Check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. 3. Inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the lens is in good condition with no visible damage or contamination.

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the lighting intensity within specified range at the part plane?

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the illuminance readings are below specification at multiple points in the inspection field.

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the lighting voltage or replace LEDs as required to bring intensity within range.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust lighting voltage or replace LEDs as required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Lighting voltage adjusted and intensity is now within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust lighting voltage or replace LEDs as required

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Blow dry compressed air across the lens surface to remove loose particles. Apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint-free cloth and wipe the lens surface using a single outward spiral motion from centre to edge. Inspect the lens under oblique light after cleaning and repeat if smearing or residue is visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Blow dry compressed air across the lens surface to remove loose particles. Apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint free cloth and wipe the lens surface using a single outward spiral motion from centre to edge. Inspect the lens under oblique light after cleaning and repeat if smearing or residue is visible.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Lens cleaning completed. Surface is clear with no smearing or residue visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Blow dry compressed air across the lens surface to remove loose particles. Apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint free cloth and wipe the lens surface using a single outward spiral motion from centre to edge. Inspect the lens under oblique light after cleaning and repeat if smearing or residue is visible.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the image sharpness within specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the modulation transfer function measurements are all within the lens acceptance criteria.

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is distortion within plus or minus 0.5 pixels at corner positions?

ground_truth.node_text: Distortion within ±0.5 px at corner positions?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the maximum radial distortion at the corners exceeds 0.5 pixels.

ground_truth.node_text: Distortion within ±0.5 px at corner positions?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply lens distortion correction coefficients in the vision software.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lens distortion correction coefficients in vision software

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Correction coefficients applied successfully.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply lens distortion correction coefficients in vision software

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations as required by the calibration algorithm. Run the calibration routine in the vision software and record the reprojection error.

ground_truth.node_text: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at the nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations as required by the calibration algorithm. Run the calibration routine in the vision software and record the reprojection error; confirm the result is below the limit stated in the vision system commissioning record.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Calibration complete. Five images captured and routine executed successfully.

ground_truth.node_text: Place the standard chessboard calibration target on the presentation fixture at the nominal focal distance. Capture five images from five different target orientations as required by the calibration algorithm. Run the calibration routine in the vision software and record the reprojection error; confirm the result is below the limit stated in the vision system commissioning record.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the calibration residual error within 0.1 pixel root mean square?

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the reprojection error is 0.08 pixels, well below the limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the trigger delay within plus or minus 0.5 milliseconds of specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured delay is 1.2 milliseconds outside the tolerance window.

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the trigger delay in the programmable controller programme to bring it within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust trigger delay in programmable controller programme

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Trigger delay adjusted and now measuring within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust trigger delay in programmable controller programme

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run 200 known good conforming parts through the inspection system in normal production conditions. Record the number flagged as reject by the system, calculate the false reject rate as a percentage, and document the part types and inspection features most frequently causing false rejections.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 200 known good conforming parts through the inspection system in normal production conditions. Record the number flagged as reject by the system. Calculate the false reject rate as a percentage of the 200 part sample and compare against the maximum allowed false reject rate specified for the product. Document the part types and the inspection feature most frequently causing false rejections.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test run completed with all 200 parts processed and results documented.

ground_truth.node_text: Run 200 known good conforming parts through the inspection system in normal production conditions. Record the number flagged as reject by the system. Calculate the false reject rate as a percentage of the 200 part sample and compare against the maximum allowed false reject rate specified for the product. Document the part types and the inspection feature most frequently causing false rejections.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the false reject rate below 0.5 percent?

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, we had 3 false rejects out of 200, giving us a 1.5 percent false reject rate.

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: Retrieve the stored rejection images for the last ten false accepts, confirm each retrieved image shows a visible defect, and compare the defect position against the inspection zone boundary settings.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Retrieve the stored rejection images for the last ten false accepts. 2. Confirm each retrieved image shows a visible defect. 3. Compare the defect position against the inspection zone boundary settings.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All checks completed. Images retrieved and defect positions compared to zone boundaries.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Retrieve the stored rejection images for the last ten false accepts. 2. Confirm each retrieved image shows a visible defect. 3. Compare the defect position against the inspection zone boundary settings.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Pass 10 known non-conforming parts, each with a documented defect type, through the inspection system individually. Record whether each defect is detected and confirm that the system correctly rejects all 10 parts.

ground_truth.node_text: Pass 10 known non conforming parts, each with a documented defect type, through the inspection system individually. Record whether each defect is detected and the system output for each part. Confirm that the system correctly rejects all 10 parts; any part that is accepted constitutes a false accept and requires immediate investigation before resuming production.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All 10 defect parts tested and results recorded for each one.

ground_truth.node_text: Pass 10 known non conforming parts, each with a documented defect type, through the inspection system individually. Record whether each defect is detected and the system output for each part. Confirm that the system correctly rejects all 10 parts; any part that is accepted constitutes a false accept and requires immediate investigation before resuming production.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all known rejects correctly detected?

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, two of the defective parts were incorrectly accepted by the system.

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Detection capability is insufficient. Escalate this issue for algorithm review. Do not resume production until the vision engineer has addressed the detection failures.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: detection capability insufficient, algorithm review required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I will escalate to the vision engineer immediately.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: detection capability insufficient, algorithm review required
